rows.risk: counter increments can be misread as kill or fight attribution
safe if limited to source-method validation counts
quality fields can look like match analysis if they include economy or position aggregates

globalInterpretationLimits: No killer, fight, objective, macro, mechanics, spatial, decision, or ML interpretation is authorized.
Absence, deletion, disappearance, or zero health does not prove death, destruction, objective completion, claim, deposit, secure, or reward.
